name: market-weekly-report
description: Weekly market report for the pilot markets (North America / Italy / Oceania). One command builds the movement-flow buckets B1-B4 (ROI/CM2 movement, fluctuations, losing ground, scale windows) plus a week-type header into a single self-contained multi-market tabbed HTML. Default week = latest complete matured week; NA carries a hard validation gate. Agent adds a Slack digest of signal beyond the data.
author: Analytics Team
